description: Immutable launch envelope of one attempt. The controller writes it once, under the attempt lock, before it spawns the supervisor; the supervisor, the gate, every post-receipt step and every adopter read it and never rewrite it. Secrets and the run-control token are not in it: they live in the 0600 side file.

layout.attemptDir: <assignmentDir>/runs/<NN> (NN = attempt number, two digits); the envelope field runDir names this directory
layout.gateExit: <attemptDir>/gate-exit.json (in a sandbox whose root is read-only the controller creates it empty and binds it writable; the gate fills it in place)
layout.supervisorLog: <attemptDir>/supervisor.log (supervisor stdout and stderr; free text, never parsed)

publish.rule: every file in the layout except supervisor.log is written to a temp file in the same directory, fsynced, then hard-linked to its final name with link(2); EEXIST means another writer already published it: read that one, never overwrite. The temp file is removed afterwards.
publish.envelope: written once by the controller before the supervisor exists; nobody republishes it

digest.value: "sha256:" + lowercase hex sha256 of the canonical JSON of the envelope object with the `digest` key removed
canonicalJson: objects: keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit order (JavaScript Array.prototype.sort default); keys whose value is undefined are dropped; serialized as {"k":v,...} with no whitespace
arrays: elements in order, [a,b] with no whitespace
strings: JSON.stringify escaping (\" \\ \b \f \n \r \t, other control characters as \u00XX lowercase hex, everything else literal UTF-8)
numbers: only integers in the safe range (|n| <= 2^53-1) are allowed; serialized in decimal without exponent; floats are a contract violation
booleans and null: true, false, null
digest.vector: packages/run-supervisor/contracts/vectors/envelope-digest.v1.json; both implementations must reproduce every vector byte for byte
digest.keyRestriction: all keys written by fgOS are ASCII, so UTF-16 order and byte order agree; a non-ASCII key is a contract violation

optionalFields.launch.maxOutputBytes: integer >= 1: the supervisor stops the agent (stop cause output-limit, receipt outcome output-limit) once the two capture files hold more than this together (config maxBuffer, default 10485760); absent means no limit
optionalFields.cwdLeaseFile: string: required for every mutating attempt; the supervisor declares its domain on this existing lease predecessor record. Unix also receives its description at fd 4; Windows uses the controller-held lease when cwdLeaseOwner is present
optionalFields.cwdLeaseOwner: string, Windows only: the private request channel of the controller-held lock-hold helper. The supervisor must receive its declare-domain acknowledgement before GO; helper death refuses a late producer start. No OS handle or new lock record
optionalFields.terminal.retainFailedPaneMs: terminal mode only: integer >= 1 or null. How long a pane kept for a person (any end but a clean exit) stays before terminal-control may close it; null keeps it until a person closes it; absent means 24 hours. Source: config terminal.retainFailedPaneMs
optionalFields.createdAt: object {bootId, boottimeNs}: the controller's boot id and monotonic boot time (CLOCK_BOOTTIME ns; Windows GetTickCount64 ms * 1e6) when it wrote the envelope. Windows adopt gives an unbound attempt with a free lock a 60 s start grace measured from it, on the same boot only; absent or another boot means no grace. File times are never used

fields.attemptId: string, globally unique attempt id minted by the controller (also the slot key in terminal mode)
fields.unitRunId: string, the unit run this attempt belongs to

mode.meaning: terminal requires slot, terminal, a CLI with a terminal adapter and the release-slot builtin step; direct forbids all of them

protocolId.meaning: internal-route protocol the supervisor, gate and steps must speak (internal-route.run-supervisor.v1.json)

fields.hostBin: absolute path of the fgos host binary of the release that wrote the envelope; resolved once by the controller, never through PATH or a shim
fields.payloadRoot: absolute path of the legacy-node payload root of the same release (components.legacyNode.root of the activated manifest); resolved like apps/fgos/src/legacy_exec.rs
fields.cwd: absolute working directory of the agent

mutation.meaning: mutating attempts also hold the dispatch-cwd lease (rank 30) handed to the supervisor at fd 4. Windows: a LockFileEx lock is never inherited, so the supervisor takes the attempt lock and, when mutating, the lease itself; see optionalFields.cwdLeaseFile

launch.command: string, absolute executable path of the agent CLI (resolved by resolveExecutorCommand in src/runner/dispatch/transport.mjs)
launch.env: object string -> string; the non-secret environment of the agent. Secret values are absent here and present in sideFile.env; the gate merges sideFile.env over this map

stdinPolicy.meaning: brief-file: the gate opens briefPath read-only as stdin; null: stdin is /dev/null (NUL on Windows)

launch.briefPath: absolute path of the brief file, or null when the brief travels in argv; terminal mode requires a file: the supervisor types its content at the agent
launch.outboxDir: absolute path where the agent writes result-<N>.json

capture.stdout: absolute path; the gate opens it O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_APPEND and dup2s it to fd 1
capture.stderr: absolute path; the gate opens it the same way and dup2s it to fd 2

containment.bwrapPrefix: string[] or absent; linux-gate only: the full bwrap argv prefix produced by the confinement driver (ends with `--`); never contains --die-with-parent in direct mode; the supervisor inserts its own --info-fd and appends `<hostBin> internal gate --protocol 1 --envelope <attemptDir>/envelope.json --go-fd 5`. Terminal mode: the launcher script that terminal-control starts in the pane execs bwrap with --die-with-parent and a --bind of the socket directory, then `<hostBin> internal gate --protocol 1 --envelope <attemptDir>/envelope.json --go-socket <terminal.socketPath>`

softAt.boottimeNs: integer, absolute CLOCK_BOOTTIME nanoseconds; null when no soft deadline

deadlines.idleMs: integer >= 1 or null; the supervisor stops the agent after this long without activity (agent-protocol activity source)
deadlines.gateKillGraceMs: integer >= 0, SIGTERM -> SIGKILL grace used by the gate and by kill_all; source config dispatch.gateKillGraceMs (default 10000)
deadlines.killWaitMs: integer >= 1, optional; the bound kill_all waits for the domain to be provably empty (config lock.predecessorKillWaitMs); absent means 5000
deadlines.rule: deadlines are absolute; a later start, an adopt or a resume never extends them. A bootId that differs from the current boot means every process of the attempt is already dead

cli.other: any other command name selects the generic adapter (exit and outbox only)

mode.meaning: always equal to the top-level mode

fields.slot: object {key, groupKey}; present exactly when mode is terminal. key: terminal-control key, equal to attemptId. groupKey: the Node client's serialization group for allocate (a string the controller chooses); the supervisor never allocates, it only addresses the slot by key
fields.terminal: object {socketPath, exitCommand, orphanSettleMs}; present exactly when mode is terminal. socketPath: absolute AF_UNIX path of the GO socket under the runtime socket dir (mode 0700, owner is the user, name is a hash of attemptId, at most 107 bytes). exitCommand: string typed into the pane after the agent protocol reports completed, or null to use the CLI adapter's own exit command. orphanSettleMs: integer >= 0, the extra wait the gate gives the outbox after it saw a result while the supervisor is gone (orphan branch)
fields.identity: object {writerId, parentWriterId}; both modes. writerId: the attempt's writer id, equal to mint_attempt_writer_id(attemptId) (packages/identity/contracts/attempt-writer-id.v1.json); the gate exports it as FGOS_SESSION_ID. parentWriterId: writer id of the controller that wrote the envelope, exported as FGOS_PARENT_WRITER_ID, or null when the controller has none

steps.type: array, run in order after the receipt; see step-receipt.v1.json. A terminal envelope ends with the release-slot builtin item; a direct envelope never carries it

builtin.meaning: run by the step runner itself in-process through the terminal-control crate: no hostBin, argv, cwd, env or stepTimeoutMs

onSuccess.meaning: terminal-control.release(key, close) when the earlier steps all have receipts

onFailure.meaning: terminal-control.release(key, retain) when an earlier step has no receipt, so the pane stays for a person

stepId.meaning: process items; release-slot is a builtinItem. cleanup-trust (terminal mode) removes the folder-trust entry the controller wrote into the agent's trust store (controller/trust-context.json); it is a no-op when the controller wrote none

item.hostBin: absolute path, normally equal to the top-level hostBin
item.payloadRoot: absolute path, normally equal to the top-level payloadRoot
item.env: object string -> string; carries FGOS_STATE_ROOT and the project root; no secrets
item.stepTimeoutMs: integer >= 1; the runner kills the step process group after this long and leaves the step without a receipt

fields.sideFile: absolute path of the side file (equal to layout.sideFile)

fields.attemptId: string, equal to the envelope's attemptId
fields.env: object string -> string, secret environment of the agent
fields.controlEpoch: integer, run-control epoch acquired by the controller for this attempt
fields.controlToken: string, run-control token of the attempt; settle uses it through commitRunSettlement and never acquires a new epoch while it exists

sideFile.readers: supervisor (gate env), settle-attempt step, adopt. Never copied into any other file, log or receipt.

invariants: the envelope is written after the attempt lock (and the cwd lease when mutating) is held and before any agent process exists
nothing in the envelope is a secret
mode terminal: slot, terminal and the release-slot builtin step are all present and slot.key equals attemptId; mode direct: none of them is present
identity.writerId equals mint_attempt_writer_id(attemptId) in both modes; a reader that finds another value refuses with envelope-invalid
a reader that finds v != 3 or a digest that does not match treats the run as legacy-run (adopt) or refuses with envelope-invalid (supervise, gate, attempt-step)
